report.summary: Ride-hailing and taxi booking, sector mixed. Peer signals are split: Rapido grew FY25 revenue 44% to Rs 934.4 crore and cut losses about 30%, and Freenow gained a deep-pocketed owner via Lyft's US$200m acquisition with expansion plans, while Gett was sold at a modest $190m valuation amid Israeli regulatory friction, Heetch is quietly cutting French staff and offshoring to Algeria, and Rapido was fined by India's consumer watchdog in September 2026. With no uniform deterioration or improvement across the sector, Cabify's unchanged 50/100 score in 2026-09 looks company-specific rather than tracking a clear sector-wide move.
findings: Rapido: India's consumer watchdog fined Rapido Rs 10 lakh (September 2026) for misleading ads, unfair practices and dark patterns, saying it displayed an initial fare and then prompted riders to pay more. [seen 2026-09-15, hurts]

Gett: VNV Global reported that the Israeli Competition Authority's review of the sale of its Gett holding had raised concerns that could potentially impact completion of the transaction. [seen 2026-08-19, hurts]

sector: Algeria's ride-hailing market is consolidating around Yassir ($193M raised, 45 cities), Temtem (4,000+ drivers, 21 wilayas) and Heetch after Yango's regulatory-driven exit in August 2024, with the Transport Ministry developing updated VTC rules and taxi pricing (April 2026). [seen 2026-04-10, neutral]

Rapido: Rapido's parent Roppen Transportation Services narrowed FY25 (year ended March 2025) losses 30% to Rs 258.4 crore from Rs 370.7 crore in FY24 while revenue crossed Rs 900 crore. [seen 2026-01-20, helps]

Rapido: Rapido's operating revenue rose 44% to Rs 934.4 crore in FY25 (ended March 2025) from Rs 648 crore, and including other income of Rs 68.4 crore it surpassed Rs 1,000 crore, with losses cut by 23%. [seen 2026-01-12, helps]

Freenow: Freenow, entering its first full year under Lyft ownership, outlined an expanded European growth strategy and confirmed preparations to introduce autonomous vehicles from 2026 (January 2026). [seen 2026-01-03, helps]
Heetch: Heetch is discreetly reducing its workforce in France and relocating operations to Algeria, with reports of degraded working conditions for drivers (November 2025). [seen 2025-11-27, hurts]

Gett: Gett was sold for $190 million (August 2025) to a six-investor consortium, each taking a 16.6% stake of about $31.66 million, with no due diligence and buyers inheriting a $70 million cash reserve. [seen 2025-08-15, hurts]

Freenow: Lyft completed its US$200m acquisition of Freenow (August 2025) after regulator approval, its first expansion outside North America, strengthening its foothold across nine European countries. [seen 2025-08-07, helps]

Gett: After Pango withdrew a previous merger agreement with Gett due to Israel's Competition Authority opposition, a restructured $190M deal with Leumi Partners and five investors, none holding control, was initiated to sidestep scrutiny (June 2025). [seen 2025-06-11, neutral]
